bos_rule: tokenizer(text, add_special_tokens=True); the Pythia/GPT-NeoX tokenizer adds no BOS token, so position 0 is the first text token
train_eval_overlap: RX partitions use WikiText-103 train articles starting after row 400,000; the SAE training store (first 5M tokens) ends before that row (asserted in rx/prep.py), so they are article-disjoint from SAE training. Overlap with the model's pretraining corpus (the Pile) is not controlled.
